_meta.description: The paired and unequal-covariance forms of TEST_HOTELLING_T2: a paired test of the revenue profile against its pre-treatment baseline (fields2 holds the matching before-members, so the test runs on the row-wise difference vector against mu = 0), and a two-sample test of the engagement profile by treatment with variance unequal (Krishnamoorthy–Yu), for arms whose spread differs. At one member the paired form is the paired t-test squared and the unequal form is Welch's t-test.
_meta.name: hotelling_t2_paired_and_unequal
